judge.voice: Jo, I liked it more than the English club. I said "nevím" and it told me how to say "I don't know", so next time I said it in English and felt clever. Mia asked about Biscuit, then my dog, then Minecraft and creeper — that was fun. The help buttons were easy to find. But Mia's first question was weird, and "where Biscuit sleeps" was too hard. "What is Creeper like?" I didn't know how to answer. The end notes about "the ball" and "dogs" were boring, like school. The topic list was huge, with a "booking" and a "group project" — nuda. Short and no reading is good, and I spoke nearly the whole time. I'd use it again, and I'd tell kluci about the Minecraft one.
